sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 8 February 2026, pitch SYN-SYNCP000114-P1 was put before Desert Bloom Family Clinic 114 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 2 rebate of 3.5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a Tdap preferred-position minimum of 85 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer turned the terms down.
